issues: Meaning drift: heading 'Mengingat' was translated as 'Considering' (should be 'In view of/Considering' but must match the legal heading; also letter case mismatch 'C.' vs 'c.' is minor but acceptable).
Meaning drift: Item 15 'Penanggulangan Pekerjaan Anak' was mistranslated as 'Prevention of Child Labor' (should be 'Countermeasures/Handling of Child Labor').
Meaning drift: 'Daerah Kabupaten Sumenep' refers to the Regional People's Representative Council of Sumenep Regency; 'Regional House of Representatives' is not the standard/accurate rendering.
Omission: the word 'DAERAH' (Regional) is not reflected as part of the institution's formal name in the translation.
Scrambled/merged numbering: items 1 and 2 are on the same line; items 14–16 and 17–18 are merged instead of being separate numbered points.
Meaning drift: 'Korban adalah perempuan anak' should be 'women and children' (not 'a woman or child').
Extraneous leftover heading/word at end: 'Penyelenggaraan/Implementation' appears after item 18 and is not part of Article 1 definitions list.
Meaning drift: "kepentingan terbaik bagi korban" translated as "the best interests of victims"; should be singular "the victim" to match the original.

Meaning drift/awkward clause attachment: "the best interests of children that occur" incorrectly makes "best interests" the thing that occurs; original means violence occurs in household/public and protection is based on best interests of the child. Also "children" should be singular conceptually (best interests of the child).

Meaning drift: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" or "Regent's Regulation" (not "Regent Regulation" without possessive is acceptable, but better as "Regent Regulation" is fine); however the main issue is that the original has paragraphs (3) and (4) run together in one line, but translation already separates—no issue. Actually meaning drift: "dalam wadah P2TP2A" is better rendered as "under/within the P2TP2A" rather than "within the framework of"; minor but could affect legal indicator.

Meaning drift/awkward clause: paragraph (2) and (3) use 'whether carried out'/'which is carried out' without clearly referring to the violence; needs to explicitly tie location to the act of violence to match the Indonesian text.
Meaning drift: 'Pembina Utama Muda' is a civil-service rank and was mistranslated as 'Principal Senior Supervisor'.
Formatting/structure: the Indonesian text presents two names followed by the rank; the English translation should preserve that structure and not attach the rank as an English job title.
Meaning drift: "Garis Komando" and "Garis Koordinasi" are mistranslated as "COMMAND LINE" and "COORDINATION LINE"; should be "Line of Command" and "Line of Coordination".

Meaning drift/format: "Nomor Tanggal" rendered as "NUMBER DATE" and the following line is awkwardly structured; should reflect "Number" and "Date" fields ("Number: 6 of 2011"; "Date: 14 February 2011").
